title: CLIP symmetric contrastive loss
summary: Normalize image and text embeddings, build the temperature-scaled similarity matrix, and compute the symmetric InfoNCE loss and its gradient.

paper.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision

mutants.grad_no_half: Adds the two gradient terms and divides by N, not by 2N.
mutants.grad_rows_twice: Uses the row softmax for the text term of the gradient, not the column softmax.
mutants.image_loss_only: Returns only the image to text cross-entropy and drops the text to image term.
mutants.no_max_shift: Calls np.exp on the raw logits, so large logits overflow to infinity.
mutants.no_normalize: Skips the L2 normalization, so the logits depend on the length of each embedding.
mutants.times_temperature: Multiplies the similarities by the temperature instead of dividing by it.
